goal: Implement Slice S3 of docs/specs/deepen-authority-seams.spec.md (Initiative deepen-authority-seams): runtime/kernel/enrollment.ts exposes one Enrollment entry that issues the capability, rehearses and commits; the four production callers use it. Gate semantics and gate copy do not change.

acceptance.assertion: Per D3 of docs/specs/deepen-authority-seams.spec.md (source U1; CONTEXT.md Enrollment): one exported Enrollment entry issues the capability for a supplied binding, runs the zero-write rehearsal, then commits. Positive: a ready rehearsal enrolls the Task atomically. Negative: a rehearsal that is not ready rejects with its blockers in the single shared 'Kernel enrollment rehearsal failed' message and leaves zero Kernel writes. Bound: replay of a lost Enrollment behaves as before, and runEnrollmentRehearsal remains a zero-write precheck. Agreed seams: tests/kernel-enrollment-transaction.test.ts, tests/kernel-canary-rehearsal.test.ts.

Per the D3 sequence of docs/specs/deepen-authority-seams.spec.md: the entry calls an optional caller checkpoint after a ready rehearsal and before commit. Positive: with no checkpoint or an accepting one, Enrollment commits. Negative: a declining checkpoint returns a cancelled outcome with zero Kernel writes. Bound: once commit has started, cancellation has no effect. The Pi enroll Tool still reports the rehearsing and committing stages and honors abort between them. Agreed seams: tests/pi-canary-enroll-extension.test.ts, tests/enrollment-confirmation-relocation.test.ts.

Per D3 and invariant I1 of docs/specs/deepen-authority-seams.spec.md: the Claude enroll path, the Pi enroll Tool and both hosts' Batch child enrollment call the single entry; no production caller outside runtime/kernel/enrollment.ts sequences rehearsal and commit itself. Literal-user and derived-child bindings are both accepted. Existing assertions in the named suites are not weakened. Agreed seams: tests/claude-host-authority.test.ts, tests/pi-batch-authority.test.ts, tests/claude-batch-authority.test.ts, tests/enrollment-dirty-scope.test.ts.

plugins/immune-brain/dist/claude/mcp-server.mjs is regenerated from the changed runtime sources and matches a fresh generate; no hand edit to the bundle. Agreed seam: tests/claude-host-package.test.ts.
